//! Typed errors for chunking operations.

use thiserror::Error;

/// Result of a chunk operation with metadata.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct ChunkResult {
    pub chunks: Vec<String>,
    pub is_binary: bool,
    pub fallback_used: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Error, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub enum ChunkError {
    #[error("file is binary")]
    BinaryFile,

    #[error("parse error: {0}")]
    ParseError(String),

    #[error("chunking timeout after {elapsed_ms}ms")]
    ChunkingTimeout { elapsed_ms: u64 },

    #[error("chunk limit exceeded: {count} > {limit}")]
    ChunkLimitExceeded { count: usize, limit: usize },

    #[error("AST depth exceeded: depth {depth} > limit {limit}")]
    ASTDepthExceeded { depth: usize, limit: usize },

    #[error("I/O error: {0}")]
    Io(String),
}

//! Tasksfile YAML schema — types representing the Tasksfile format.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Top-level Tasksfile root.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TasksfileRoot {
    pub version: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub metadata: Metadata,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub templates: HashMap<String, TemplateDefinition>,
    pub tasks: HashMap<String, TaskDefinition>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub includes: Vec<IncludeSpec>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub hooks: GlobalHooks,
}

/// File-level metadata.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct Metadata {
    pub name: Option<String>,
    pub description: Option<String>,
    pub shell: Option<String>,
    pub log_level: Option<String>,
    pub cache_ttl: Option<u64>,
}

/// Named template (e.g., `ci_job`) applied to tasks via `template: true`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TemplateDefinition {
    pub timeout: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub retry_policy: Option<RetryPolicyDef>,
}

/// Retry policy shared across tasks.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct RetryPolicyDef {
    pub max_attempts: usize,
    #[serde(default = "default_backoff_ms")]
    pub backoff_ms: u64,
    #[serde(default = "default_backoff_multiplier")]
    pub backoff_multiplier: f64,
}

fn default_backoff_ms() -> u64 { 1000 }
fn default_backoff_multiplier() -> f64 { 2.0 }

/// Individual task definition within a Tasksfile.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TaskDefinition {
    pub desc: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub template: bool,
    pub command: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub deps: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub env: HashMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub params: HashMap<String, ParamDefinition>,
    pub timeout: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    pub complexity_hint: Option<String>,
    pub deadline: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub deadline_behavior: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub review_required: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub retry_policy: Option<RetryPolicyDef>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub env_file: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub hooks: TaskHooks,
}

/// Parameter definition with optional default and allowed options.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ParamDefinition {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub required: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub default: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub options: Option<Vec<String>>,
    pub description: Option<String>,
}

/// External file or URL include.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct IncludeSpec {
    pub file: Option<String>,
    pub url: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default = "default_path_resolve")]
    pub path_resolve: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub auth: Option<NetrcAuth>,
}

fn default_path_resolve() -> String { "relative".to_string() }

/// .netrc authentication for URL includes.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NetrcAuth {
    pub machine: String,
    #[serde(rename = "type", default = "default_auth_type")]
    pub auth_type: String,
    pub username: Option<String>,
    pub password: Option<String>,
}

fn default_auth_type() -> String { "basic".to_string() }

/// Global hooks (before_all, after_all, on_failure).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct GlobalHooks {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub before_all: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub after_all: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub on_failure: Vec<String>,
}

/// Per-task hooks (before_task, after_task, on_failure).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct TaskHooks {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub before_task: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub after_task: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub on_failure: Vec<String>,
}

diagnostics.source_snippet:
use thiserror::Error;

/// Errors that can occur when operating on a vector store.
#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum VectorStoreError {
    #[error("backend not available — enable one of the feature flags: sqlite-vec, qdrant, or in-memory")]
    BackendNotAvailable,

    #[error("failed to connect to backend: {0}")]
    ConnectionFailed(String),

    #[error("collection not found: {0}")]
    CollectionNotFound(String),

    #[error("failed to upsert points: {0}")]
    UpsertFailed(String),

    #[error("search failed: {0}")]
    SearchFailed(String),

    #[error("delete failed: {0}")]
    DeleteFailed(String),

    #[error("invalid dimension: expected {expected} but got {actual}")]
    InvalidDimension { expected: usize, actual: usize },

    #[error("persistence error: {0}")]
    PersistenceError(String),
}

//! Typed errors for chunking operations.

use thiserror::Error;

/// Result of a chunk operation with metadata.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct ChunkResult {
    pub chunks: Vec<String>,
    pub is_binary: bool,
    pub fallback_used: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Error, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub enum ChunkError {
    #[error("file is binary")]
    BinaryFile,

    #[error("parse error: {0}")]
    ParseError(String),

    #[error("chunking timeout after {elapsed_ms}ms")]
    ChunkingTimeout { elapsed_ms: u64 },

    #[error("chunk limit exceeded: {count} > {limit}")]
    ChunkLimitExceeded { count: usize, limit: usize },

    #[error("AST depth exceeded: depth {depth} > limit {limit}")]
    ASTDepthExceeded { depth: usize, limit: usize },

    #[error("I/O error: {0}")]
    Io(String),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TemplateDefinition {
    pub timeout: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub retry_policy: Option<RetryPolicyDef>,
}

/// Retry policy shared across tasks.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct RetryPolicyDef {
    pub max_attempts: usize,
    #[serde(default = "default_backoff_ms")]
    pub backoff_ms: u64,
    #[serde(default = "default_backoff_multiplier")]
    pub backoff_multiplier: f64,
}

fn default_backoff_ms() -> u64 { 1000 }
fn default_backoff_multiplier() -> f64 { 2.0 }

/// Individual task definition within a Tasksfile.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct TaskDefinition {
    pub desc: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub template: bool,
    pub command: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub deps: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub env: HashMap<String, String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub params: HashMap<String, ParamDefinition>,
    pub timeout: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    pub complexity_hint: Option<String>,
    pub deadline: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub deadline_behavior: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub review_required: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub retry_policy: Option<RetryPolicyDef>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub env_file: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub hooks: TaskHooks,
}

/// Parameter definition with optional default and allowed options.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ParamDefinition {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub required: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub default: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub options: Option<Vec<String>>,
    pub description: Option<String>,
}

/// External file or URL include.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct IncludeSpec {
    pub file: Option<String>,
    pub url: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default = "default_path_resolve")]
    pub path_resolve: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub auth: Option<NetrcAuth>,
}

fn default_path_resolve() -> String { "relative".to_string() }

/// .netrc authentication for URL includes.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct NetrcAuth {
    pub machine: String,
    #[serde(rename = "type", default = "default_auth_type")]
    pub auth_type: String,
    pub username: Option<String>,
    pub password: Option<String>,
}

fn default_auth_type() -> String { "basic".to_string() }

/// Global hooks (before_all, after_all, on_failure).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct GlobalHooks {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub before_all: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub after_all: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub on_failure: Vec<String>,
}

/// Per-task hooks (before_task, after_task, on_failure).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct TaskHooks {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub before_task: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub after_task: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub on_failure: Vec<String>,
}

findings.source_snippet:
use thiserror::Error;

/// Errors that can occur when operating on a vector store.
#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum VectorStoreError {
    #[error("backend not available — enable one of the feature flags: sqlite-vec, qdrant, or in-memory")]
    BackendNotAvailable,

    #[error("failed to connect to backend: {0}")]
    ConnectionFailed(String),

    #[error("collection not found: {0}")]
    CollectionNotFound(String),

    #[error("failed to upsert points: {0}")]
    UpsertFailed(String),

    #[error("search failed: {0}")]
    SearchFailed(String),

    #[error("delete failed: {0}")]
    DeleteFailed(String),

    #[error("invalid dimension: expected {expected} but got {actual}")]
    InvalidDimension { expected: usize, actual: usize },

    #[error("persistence error: {0}")]
    PersistenceError(String),
}
